name: What is the typical lifespan of weather-resistant outdoor cabinetry?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of weather-resistant outdoor cabinetry?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of weather-resistant outdoor cabinetry varies significantly based on the material, exposure to elements, and maintenance. High-quality marine-grade polymer or stainless steel cabinets can last 15-25 years or more with proper care. Wood options like teak, while naturally durable, may require more frequent maintenance, such as oiling, to achieve a similar lifespan. When planning your outdoor kitchen, consider the long-term durability and maintenance requirements of different materials as a practical tradeoff against initial cost and desired aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-quality weather-resistant outdoor cabinetry can last 15-25+ years, depending on material, exposure, and maintenance. Marine-grade polymer and stainless steel offer superior longevity.
